sources_read: .qc-cache/coldwater-strict-2026-10-02-r3/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx :: Quality Checks row 17 (#16) and Internal Quality Checks row 17 (#16); no cell comments on either row
.qc-cache/coldwater-strict-2026-10-02-r3/task/tests/**/judge.toml, prompt.md, app_context.md (machine comparison against the public notes only)
evidence: Source-level review; no agent image was built or inspected by this reviewer. (1) task/environment/Dockerfile is byte-identical to the frozen template Dockerfile (diff empty). Its only COPY lines are 14-15 (`COPY instructions/ /instructions/`, `COPY assets/ /assets/`); there is no COPY of solution/ or tests/. Lines 17-23 create /app, git-init it and commit only `.gitkeep`, so /app starts with nothing but .gitkeep. (2) The build context task/environment/ holds exactly Dockerfile, assets/seed_data.json and six instruction notes; no hidden files, no starter, skeleton, schema or partial UI. (3) assets/seed_data.json:2-3 is `"snippets": []` plus a one-sentence scope note; it carries no code, schema or route list. (4) The notes describe behaviour only. integration.md:3,9 names the mandated runtime contract (node /app/server.js, 0.0.0.0:3000, GET /api/health, /app/app.db, DB_PATH) and policy.md:3 leaves layout, labels, routes, schema and wording to the builder; no implementation, route list or table design is supplied. (5) A scripted 8-word shingle comparison of instruction.md, the six notes and the seed against every tests/**/*.toml and *.md found zero shared runs, and none of the 54 id/name values in the judge files appear in the public files. A grep of the public files for judge|rubric|criteri|dimension|reward|weight|score.py|playwright|claude|glm|/tests|sentinel|GATE|PROBE|solution|golden|oracle|likert returned no hits. (6) task.toml:28 sets environment_mode = "separate" and tests/Dockerfile:46 copies tests only into the verifier image, so criteria are not present in the agent's world. Counterexample attempts: a weak app cannot obtain a finished copy from /app, /assets or /instructions because none exists there; a conforming builder is not disadvantaged by anything missing, since the ask and the scope note are both present. The raw-evidence index covers scripted golden behaviour only and is not relevant measurement for this row; its artifact hashes were not re-verified here. Not checked and outside what the frozen bytes can show: whether a copy of the reference app is reachable on the public internet (network_mode is public, task.toml:22; provenance 'Adapted from the supplied Colderwater playground task', task.toml:14).
